name: document-rag-backend
description: Production-grade RAG Document QA Backend with Node.js, Express, ChromaDB, and OpenAI

scripts.chroma: python -c "import sys; from chromadb.cli.cli import app; sys.argv=['chroma', 'run', '--path', './chroma_data', '--port', '8000']; app()"
scripts.test: node --test test/localDocumentStore.test.js test/localAccess.test.js test/chunkingService.test.js test/ragService.test.js test/retrievalService.test.js test/pdfService.test.js
